verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.pt: Os céus declaram a glória de Deus; e o firmamento anuncia a obra de suas mãos.
verses.en_web: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> The heavens are sounding the glory of God; the arch of the sky makes clear the work of his hands.

verses.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.pt: Dia após dia ele fala; e noite após noite ele mostra sabedoria.
verses.en_web: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: Day after day it sends out its word, and night after night it gives knowledge.

verses.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.pt: Não há língua, nem palavras, onde não se ouça a voz deles.
verses.en_web: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.en_bbe: There are no words or language; their voice makes no sound.

verses.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.pt: Por toda a terra sai sua corda, e suas palavras até o fim do mundo; para o sol ele pôs uma tenda neles.
verses.en_web: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
verses.en_bbe: Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he put a tent for the sun,

verses.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.pt: E ele é como o noivo, que sai de sua câmara; e se alegra como um homem valente, para correr seu caminho.
verses.en_web: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
verses.en_bbe: Who is like a newly married man coming from his bride-tent, and is glad like a strong runner starting on his way.

verses.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.pt: Desde uma extremidade dos céus é sua saída, e seu curso até as outras extremidades deles; e nada se esconde de seu calor.
verses.en_web: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends; There is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.en_bbe: His going out is from the end of the heaven, and his circle to the ends of it; there is nothing which is not open to his heat.

verses.en: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.pt: A lei do SENHOR é perfeita, e restaura a alma; o testemunho do SENHOR é fiel, e da sabedoria aos simples.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s testimony is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.en_bbe: The law of the Lord is good, giving new life to the soul: the witness of the Lord is certain, giving wisdom to the foolish.

verses.en: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.pt: Os preceitos do SENHOR são corretos, e alegram ao coração; o mandamento do SENHOR é puro, e ilumina aos olhos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.en_bbe: The orders of the Lord are right, making glad the heart: the rule of the Lord is holy, giving light to the eyes.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
verses.pt: O temor ao SENHOR é limpo, e permanece para sempre; os juízos do SENHOR são verdade; juntamente são justos.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is clean, and has no end; the decisions of the Lord are true and full of righteousness.

verses.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.pt: São mais desejáveis que ouro, mais do que muito ouro fino; e mais doces que o mel, e o licor de seus favos.
verses.en_web: More to be desired are they than gold, yes, than much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
verses.en_bbe: More to be desired are they than gold, even than much shining gold; sweeter than the dropping honey.

verses.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.pt: Também por eles teu servo é advertido; por guardá-los, há muita recompensa.
verses.en_web: Moreover by them is your servant warned. In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.en_bbe: By them is your servant made conscious of danger, and in keeping them there is great reward.

verses.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.pt: Quem pode entender seus próprios erros? Limpa-me dos que me são ocultos.
verses.en_web: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
verses.en_bbe: Who has full knowledge of his errors? make me clean from secret evil.

verses.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.pt: Também retém a teu servo de arrogâncias, para que elas não me controlem; então eu serei sincero, e ficarei limpo de grande transgressão.
verses.en_web: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
verses.en_bbe: Keep your servant back from sins of pride; let them not have rule over me: then will I be upright and free from great sin.

verses.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.pt: Sejam agradáveis as palavras de minha boca, e o pensamento do meu coração, diante de ti, ó SENHOR, minha rocha e meu Libertador. Salmo de Davi, para o regente:
verses.en_web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
verses.en_bbe: Let the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be pleasing in your eyes, O Lord, my strength and my salvation.
